# Copilot entry point

Read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md` before working. It is the
canonical rulebook; this file adds no separate policy.

Use `docs/08-cli-build-guide.md` for startup and the task-specific handoff for
current state. `.github/agents/` and `.github/skills/` are optional Copilot
wrappers over the authoritative `docs/` playbooks. Their availability does
not grant implementation, content, release, commit, or push approval.
